rows.reviewScope: Both complete three-page guidance outputs, their map, instructions, source receipt, actual-writes report, rendered-artifact inventory, and product wiring. This is process guidance, not a prepared SBI application or court filing.

nineCounters.scope: Observed guidance-output completeness, not participant eligibility or proof that an agency application is delivered. Seven unavailable fact categories are explicitly disclosed for participant completion. Integration defects below independently prevent a complete family-level pass.

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: The guide correctly serves the single mandatory/automatic SBI process route and expressly must not be filed. Current product-wiring binding.deliveryType and proposedRepresentation.outputStrategy nevertheless say participant_agency_application, with primary_filing roles. Align the downstream delivery contract with the settled guidance treatment; do not invent an SBI application PDF.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: Read the current official DSP process and 11 Del. C. 4372(l), 4373 and 4373A. Visually read the linked one-page 27S23V enrollment sheet. It is an enrollment/service-code sheet, not an expungement application for LegalEase to recreate. The September 7 fee-scope correction and source receipt identify the same official process. No printed service-sheet revision is established; the URL's 2023/09 directory is not a revision claim.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: One agency_preparation_guide component, three pages in each fixture. No conditional component is declared or missing from this guidance treatment. A phantom application is not a missing component.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Compared the five declared identity/contact writes in each fixture with all visible pages and reports/actual-writes.json. Name, DOB, complete mailing address, telephone and email are visible; the long boundary values remain readable. No unheld case facts were substituted.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: All seven required-before-use categories are disclosed: case identity, custody/supervision, financial obligations, other/pending matters, outcomes/dates, record status, and SBI letter/instructions. The guide does not claim to determine eligibility, case dates, debts, or agency status. The report vocabulary says before filing, but the participant-facing guide expressly says it is not filed.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: Automatic-status inquiry comes first. The manual SBI enrollment path is conditional; discretionary court relief is separate. No signature, attestation, legal election or eligibility finding is made for the participant.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: No case rows are held or automatically populated. The checklist asks for every case identifier and charge, rather than fabricating or truncating a supplied charge list.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: No participant signature/date, notarization, agency determination, judicial finding, or clerk/prosecutor execution field is completed. Checklist blanks remain blank in both fixtures.

ARTIFACTS.finding: The reviewed output inventory and central receipt agree on both current hashes and all six pages. However product-wiring.json still proposes canonical SHA-256 1234befd09bd234d02f341b6170148e6ef4167e81520f9417957cdacec0b81e1 and the older run 34060252924 receipt, rather than the current f08e5968... output and run 34078415178. A must refresh the proposed binding before consumption. The central receipt itself is not defective.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: Individually inspected canonical and boundary pages 1 through 3 in order: preparation/process guidance followed by the required-information checklist. Six of six pages are present. The canonical page-1/page-2 continuation does not omit the SBI telephone number.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: Individually inspected every retained central page image. No clipped or overlapping written facts, missing glyphs, or illegible boundary values observed. This is a visual review, not a claim to have rerun the builder or raster engine.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: The guide says do not file it with a court or agency. It directs the participant to SBI and official fingerprint enrollment, then to the participant-specific SBI instructions. A discretionary petition has a different destination and is not represented by this guide.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The manual process correctly states $72 initially, then $75 payable to Delaware State Police only after mandatory eligibility and return of signed paperwork within 30 days of receipt. No third court filing charge is imposed, and personal-report code 27RVGT is not substituted for 27S23V. Automatic processing is not conditioned on these manual-path charges. Section 4372(l) unpaid-obligation waiver/conversion is separately flagged for legal help, not supplied as a fabricated waiver.

SERVICE.finding: No service on a prosecutor, court, or respondent is invented for this non-filed guidance document. SBI's own paperwork and current submission instructions control the subsequent agency process.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: The guide stops at denial, a court-petition direction, an uncleared record, uncertain case facts, or immigration/firearms/licensing/registry/law-enforcement-employment consequences. It makes no participant-specific legal eligibility or downstream-rights guarantee.
